title: Fine grained crash when class is turned into a generic class
body:
`a.py`:

```py
import b
def f() -> b.C: pass
```

Original `b.py`:

```py
import a
class C: pass
```

Updated `b.py`:

```py
from typing import TypeVar, Generic
import a

T = TypeVar('T')
class C(Generic[T]): pass

reveal_type(a.f)
c: C[int]
d = a.f()
d = c
c = d
```

Now if I run `mypy --quick a.py` first with the original files, then with the updated `b.py`, I get a crash:
